title: DIO time elevation ignores enclosing RPL instance and DODAG context
description: Post-fix correctness review: DioTimeVerifier parses DIO but authorizes only signer+stratum; it ignores RPLInstanceID, DODAG ID/current DODAG, MOP, root/peer role, and relevant version. An authorized key can elevate time from a different DODAG/instance. The unified sealed AuthenticatedDio must bind validated IPv6 pseudoheader, canonical DIO, expected instance/DODAG/role, exact option spans, signer/replay/key-generation/receipt time; fixed consumers derive without reparse. Add wrong-instance/DODAG/MOP vectors.
